player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop trying to remic the book and the unbal, repeatedly attempting to make them unobstructed and uncovered without actually achieving the goal. What's worse, I never actually moved the book to the table or the unbal to the table, and I never even tried to put the gaticed on the table. Next time, I will first try to move the book to the table by using the "move" action, and then attempt to remic the unbal and put the gaticed on the table. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried action instead of remicing the same object.
